property_performance.noi.ytd_actual.formula: revenue - expenses from Interim IS cumulative at ytd_date

depends_on: ISBS Interim BS DEBT_BS_ACCTS balance delta

property_performance.dscr.ytd_budget.formula: noi.ytd_budget / abs(5190 + 7060 summed over Budget IS range)

property_performance.dscr.uw_ye.formula: noi.uw_ye / account 7010 YTD at December, annualised by 12/months_active when the cumulative stopped growing early

property_performance.economic_occ.uw_ye.formula: (1 - vacancy(4030+4031) / abs(rental 4010)) * 100 from Projected IS December

property_performance.revenue|expenses|no.formula: YTD actual + remainder-of-year Budget (or full-year Budget when no current-year actuals)
property_performance.revenue|expenses|no.gate: the prior-year budget shift (one_pager.py:1419) is SKIPPED for dev deals — config.DEV_STRATEGIES

property_performance.*.variance.formula: ytd_actual - ytd_budget, None when either side is None

snapshot_financial.total_cap.formula: debt_leg + total_pref + ptr_equity, re-footed from the PRINTED debt (committed on a dev deal)
snapshot_financial.total_cap.fallback: cap.total_cap_isbs when any leg is None (an unknown leg is not a zero)
snapshot_financial.total_cap.sold_rule: debt_leg = 0 when 'debt' is in the n/a cells for that row

snapshot_financial.total_cap_funded.note: audit twin, funded throughout — deliberately keeps the ISBS debt leg; nothing renders it today

snapshot_financial.invested.note: always FUNDED, never total_pref — the identity that proves Total Pref is committed

suppressions: raw > ltv_ceiling -> withheld with a review flag (non-dev only)

snapshot_loan.debt_yield.alt: debt_yield_ytd_annualised = (ytd_noi / months_elapsed * 12) / debt — comparison basis only

aggregates.unit_trap: a typed LTV/debt-yield stores DISPLAY units (69.0) and is divided by 100; DSCR passes through

aggregates.rule: sum over every deal, development included, sold_suppressed excluded
sum of the VISIBLE cells; a suppressed cell contributes 0 and is counted in noi_contributors
NOI-weighted mean over rows whose occupancy cell is visible; weight is the VISIBLE NOI

aggregates.note: lookthrough_pct_pe, NOT lookthrough_pct — the deal-level pct removes the OP stake a second time (Pegasus $2,144,757.65)
